SMART-QSO 1U | SQSO-MECH-CAD-001 Sheet 1: stowed configuration | dimensions mm | envelope per CDS Rev 14.1 drawing CDS-14-001 (1U)

Rails: 8.5 x 8.5 mm square envelope (L-angle with 1.5 mm legs between the end frames, solid 8.5 x 8.5 x 6.75 mm standoffs at both ends), continuous over 113.5 mm (100 % contact); hard anodized Type III, Ra < 1.6 um, edges R >= 1 mm (frame vendor).
Dashed orange: the 6.5 mm protrusion envelope on +-X/+-Y. First protrusion >= 9.0 mm from every rail edge (CDS 2.2.5: >= 8.5).
Stowed stack from the rail plane: wing front cells 4.75, hold-down line 5.25, hinge spring 6.10 mm (governing); worst-case tolerance stack 6.38 mm, RSS 6.25 mm (STR-10).

Deployment switches (inhibits, BASELINE 4): DS1 rail +X+Y at -Z, DS2 rail -X-Y at -Z, DS3 rail +X-Y at +Z, each at (+-46.0, +-46.0) mm in its standoff; separation plungers SP1 rail -X+Y and SP2 rail +X-Y at -Z (CDS 2.2.14).

All switches and plungers actuated or compressed flush with the standoff end (CDS 2.3.2.3, 2.2.14.2). RBF and access port on -Y in the -Z end zone of the panel (no cells); Nova access window to be confirmed (LVR-068).
Stowed mass 1492.7 g CBE / 1725.9 g MEV; CG (+0.4, -0.2, -1.8) mm CBE. Hidden lines grey dashed. Generated by hardware/mechanical/model.py.
